scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.dev:api-server: pnpm --dir ./artifacts/api-server exec cross-env PORT=8080 pnpm run dev
scripts.start:api-server: pnpm --dir ./artifacts/api-server exec cross-env PORT=8080 pnpm run start
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
